summary: TYPE_COLOR.skill='#bb88ff' (= --pur) is identical to .si-state.active CSS color (var(--pur) = #bb88ff). For nodes sk1 and sk2 (type=skill, state=active), both the si-dot (TYPE channel) and si-state label (STATE channel) resolve to --pur #bb88ff. The viewer cannot distinguish 'this node is a skill' (TYPE) from 'this node is active' (STATE) — both channels carry identical signal. This is a TYPE/STATE color collapse. Scope is sk1+sk2 only. Secondary finding: the collapse is SYSTEMIC — verified via exhaustive node/state collision map: 7/14 nodes across 4 pairs collapse (skill+active, memory+canon, source+live, task+waiting). Root cause: TYPE_COLOR and .si-state share the same 5-hue palette (--pur, --cy, --grn, --amb, --mg) without partitioning between type-identity and lifecycle-state channels.
evidence: Collision map (14 nodes, 7 collapse): m1+m2 (memory+canon: --cy), s2+s3 (source+live: --grn), t3 (task+waiting: --amb), sk1+sk2 (skill+active: --pur)

Non-collapsing pairs: claim+pending (--mg vs --amb), claim+shipped (--mg vs --grn), memory+active (--cy vs --pur), source+dirty (--grn vs --red), task+todo (--amb vs --cy-dim), task+blocked (--amb vs --red)
hypothesis: TYPE_COLOR.skill=--pur = .si-state.active=--pur creates TYPE/STATE signal collapse on skill+active nodes. Single-constant tweak TYPE_COLOR.skill → #d4aaff (lavender, not in any STATE_CSS value) resolves sk1/sk2 collapse without semantic side effects. The broader systemic issue (4 pair collisions) requires operator-level palette partitioning.
proposed_tweak: PROPOSAL ONLY — no edit applied: TYPE_COLOR.skill: '#bb88ff' → '#d4aaff' (lavender). Rationale: #d4aaff is visually in the purple family (preserving 'skills = purple-adjacent' visual language) but is distinct from --pur (#bb88ff) so TYPE and STATE channels become independently legible on sk1/sk2. Verified: #d4aaff is not used in any STATE_CSS value (pending=#ffaa00, shipped=#00ff88, canon=#00e5ff, dirty=#ff3355, live=#00ff88, todo=rgba(0,229,255,.5), blocked=#ff3355, waiting=#ffaa00, active=#bb88ff). Scope: 1 constant line change; effect at L231 (TYPE_COLOR), propagates to L347 (orbital canvas), L384 (selected-node title), L459 (si-dot). Reversible: revert one line.
metric: After tweak: python3 collision script → 7 collapse nodes reduce to 5 (sk1+sk2 no longer collapse; m1+m2+s2+s3+t3 remain pending further operator decisions). Observable: sk1 si-dot (#d4aaff) ≠ si-state.active (#bb88ff) — distinct. sk2 same. TYPE and STATE channels independently legible for skill nodes.
keep_rule: KEEP finding: TYPE/STATE collapse confirmed on sk1/sk2, systemic across 7/14 nodes and 4 color pairs. Skill+active collapse is the E77 scope; #d4aaff proposal is minimal and reversible. HOLD broader palette partitioning for operator review — systemic fix requires multi-pair decision. REJECT immediate edit: operator sign-off required.
